lines.ruling: Ruling: model error; Form 2441 line 3, "If you completed Part III, enter the amount from line 31"; i2441 p. 6, Line 26, "If line 26 is more than zero, you have taxable dependent care benefits. Enter this amount on Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 1e". executable-triage-v2 (rerun of triage.py's triage() with the witness cap lifted, record in scratch `/tmp/adj-bklg-dep-f2441/triage/f2441.json`; 1,495 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 380 partial records from 40 bases; 2,375 comparisons): 717 of 2,375 agree; 1,364 candidate-unknown, 264 candidate-refuses, 24 project-unknown, 5 project-refuses, 1 value; on completed returns: 196 candidate-unknown, 26 candidate-refuses. The expression (line 26 > 0) is the earlier reply's, but this reply's line 26 is no longer guarded by f2441.benefits: it evaluates Part III for every filer, so on returns that file no Part III it asks the Part III answers the interview never asks (f2441.line13 83, Form W-2 box 10 of every employer, f2441.plan_max, line14, paid_2026, employer_care, nondependent, student_disabled) and refuses f2441.plans_differ (25) where the project gives false. No value difference on a completed return; the 1 value is on a refused return. The project tests f1040.line1e, which copies line 26 only with benefits. Project stands.

Ruling: model error; f2441 (2025) p. 1, Part I, "If you have more than three care providers, see the instructions and check this box". The second transcription tests the provider count with no test that the return files Form 2441, as in the earlier rounds on this line. executable-triage-v2 (pass fd2fa01dda32; 1,767 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 337 partial records): 2,393 of 2,586 agree; 116 candidate-unknown, 77 project-unknown; on completed returns 14 candidate-unknown (the dcprov roster, not asked of a filer without care or benefits), no value difference. No change to the data.

Ruling: scope; i2441 p. 3, Line 2, "Don't list a person on line 2 unless they are listed as an eligible person under Qualifying Person(s), earlier". The second transcription reads f2441.nondependent on every return; the project counts dependent.dc_qp and refuses a nondependent qualifying person through f2441.nondependent_gate. executable-triage-v2 (pass fd2fa01dda32): 2,165 of 2,586 agree; 381 candidate-unknown (f2441.nondependent is asked only when f2441.care is Yes), 40 candidate-refuses on returns already refused; no value difference. No change to the data.

Ruling: scope; f2441 (2025) p. 1, line 3, "Don't enter more than $3,000 if you had one qualifying person or $6,000 if you had two or more persons". The trees differ in who is counted, as on line 2 (the candidate reads f2441.nondependent; the project counts dependent.dc_qp and refuses a nondependent qualifying person through f2441.nondependent_gate). executable-triage-v2 (pass fd2fa01dda32): 2,423 of 2,586 agree; on completed returns 89 candidate-unknown and 1 project-unknown, no value difference; the 5 value differences are all on refused returns (fixtures mutation.t2.f8880.sep_line2 and no_plan_line2, generated 96, 213 and 472), where the project's refusal stands. No change to the data.

Ruling: model error; i2441 p. 4, Lines 4 and 5, earned income includes "The amount shown on Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 1z". executable-triage-v2 (rerun of triage.py's triage() with the witness cap lifted, record in scratch `/tmp/adj-bklg-dep-f2441/triage/f2441.json`; 1,495 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 380 partial records from 40 bases; 2,375 comparisons): 2,010 of 2,375 agree; 181 candidate-refuses, 144 candidate-unknown, 24 project-refuses, 16 project-unknown; on completed returns: 58 candidate-unknown, 24 candidate-refuses. The line's own choose (spouse's earned income on a joint return, else line 4; a deceased spouse's choice taken as line 4) is the earlier reply's and the project refuses the spouse-died choice (f2441.spouse_died_gate, 2). But person.dc_earned reads person.dc_1e, which reads this reply's f2441.has_1e, so the line inherits its Part III-for-every-filer error: the 24 completed-return refusals (f2441.plans_differ 23, employer_care 1) and 58 completed unknowns all trace to f2441.has_1e -> line 26 -> line 25 (witness classm.clcw.2.deepseek, traced). No value difference. The project's refusal on f2.t121.line13_earned_refused reaches line 5 through line 1e, as it must: line 1e is not determined there. Project stands.
